request: Read-only forensic on first cold UDS prewarm returned 503 after182s; inspect physical container exit/OOM, stale socket files and bounded allowlisted llama.cpp startup log tags. Never print full raw logs or model prompts, no new model starts.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
m="AI_CORE_UDS_POST_182S_503_FORENSIC"
for n in ai-granite ai-qwen3 ai-ministral ai-coder; do
 v=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Name}}={{.State.Status}},exit={{.State.ExitCode}},oom={{.State.OOMKilled}},started={{.State.StartedAt}},finished={{.State.FinishedAt}}' "$n")
 m="$m\n$v"
done
s=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate sh -c 'for n in granite qwen3 ministral coder; do p=/run/ai-core-backend/$n.sock; if test -S "$p"; then echo "$n=SOCKET_PRESENT"; else echo "$n=NO_SOCKET"; fi; done')
m="$m\n$s"
for n in ai-granite ai-qwen3; do
 v=$(docker logs --since 2026-10-16T19:34:00Z --tail 400 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -Eoi 'address already in use|cannot bind|bind failed|permission denied|model load|error|failed|listening|server ready' | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ';' || :)
 m="$m\nLOG_TAGS_$n=$v"
done
printf '%b\n' "$m"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$(printf '%b' "$m")" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
